'''Horizon Development''' builds custom software and web applications, from concept to deployment, using modern technologies. It is part of [[Horizon Network]].<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/companies Our companies], hngroup.org.uk.</ref>

== Services ==
* '''Web applications'''
* '''Custom software'''
* '''From concept to deployment''' — taking a project from first idea to launch

Horizon Development turns ideas into useful software. As part of Horizon Network, its work can sit on the network's digital infrastructure and be promoted through [[Horizon Advertising]].<ref>[https://horizon-network.co.uk/services Our services], horizon-network.co.uk.</ref> Enquiries about projects are handled through the Horizon Network and HN Group contact forms.

== Structure ==
Horizon Development is part of [[Horizon Network]], which is in turn part of [[HN Group]].

== Brand ==
[[File:horizon-development-roundel.svg|thumb|The Horizon Development roundel]]
Horizon Development's logo is a thick indigo ring containing the initials '''HD''', alongside the company name. The roundel is also used on its own and as an app icon.
